topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: I can’t believe it. All those weeks, the whispers, the suspicious smiles—turns out they were just that, nothing more. I thought I had it figured out, the grand plan, the surprise attack of love and laughter. But no, the grand reveal was just a mirage. I tried to keep my cool, to play it off with a laugh, but inside, it’s like someone’s taken a sledgehammer to my chest. Everyone else seems so casual, but how can they be? How can they just shrug this off? I wanted to feel special, to be the center of something wonderful, but now, I’m just... not.
